name: Route links to destination new order
description: Every route to the firm's own ATS must have a destination new-order event with the same routed order ID on the same trade date.

name: Lifecycle timestamps in sequence
description: Within an order, no event may carry a timestamp earlier than the order's new-order event, in the system's own step order.

name: Valid field values
description: Side is B, S, or SS; quantity is positive; symbol is present.

name: Books-to-CAT completeness
description: Every execution in the books has an EXECUTE event in the reporting feed with the same execution reference.

name: Firm designated ID present
description: Firm designated ID is never null in the reporting feed.

name: Event ID unique
description: Event IDs are unique within the reporting feed.
